root_cause_addressed: Build 110 PDF.js rendering derived cssWidth from the zoomed card.clientWidth.
Build 110 rerendered at pinch end and restored the saved zoom before the next first render, allowing a high-zoom render state to reproduce on reopen.
Build 111 decouples iOS visual zoom from PDF.js raster dimensions and allows only one live heavy page surface.
